purpose: Continue the three-session offline research program after Campaign009 failed its frozen development gates. This record considers only economic meaning and accepted source-schema feasibility, rejects terminal or near-synonym mechanisms before values, and selects at most one concept for a separate exact no-value overlap audit.

concepts_rejected_before_formula_or_valu.reason: Campaign009 is terminal. Mean per-bar ratios, wick decomposition, candle-sign conditioning, thresholding, inversion, or another body/range aggregation would be prohibited rescue.
Signed path efficiency, diffusive variation ratio, return-sign runs, variance entropy, skewness, semivariance, realized volatility, and volatility timing are terminal.
Amount, share volume, amount/volume transaction price, activity response, price impact, absorption, and profile mechanisms are terminal and are excluded from this source boundary.
The 09:30 row can be a reference placeholder, opening-gap mechanisms are terminal, and the lunch transition may not be treated as an adjacent trading-minute pair.
Terminal close location and directional price-path families are terminal. The selected concept must remain direction-neutral and may not privilege the final bar.
Market-relative and cross-stock synchronization mechanisms are terminal. A peer benchmark would also introduce a different and unnecessarily broad measurement layer.

selected_concept.mechanism: Measure whether the price territory explored inside one minute remains shared with the immediately following tradable minute. This is a direction-neutral overlap of consecutive intrabar high-low intervals, not a candle body/range efficiency statistic, between-close return path, return moment, activity response, market benchmark, or transaction-price construction.
selected_concept.economic_question: Do stock-days with greater continuity of locally accepted price ranges, and therefore less fleeting one-minute price exploration, carry short-horizon resilience from the next open through the third close?
known_design_risks: overlap versus containment, pair weighting, direction, zero-width handling, lunch treatment, and minimum informative-pair count create researcher degrees of freedom unless frozen before values
raw high-low ordering must be validated fail-closed rather than repaired
using open, close, candle direction, or wicks would reopen Campaign009 or directional path families
including the lunch transition or 09:30 would reopen invalid gap mechanisms
the candidate may still be statistically redundant with volatility, price-update, or Campaign009 values even if the economic measurement is distinct

decision.required_next_step: Perform a separate no-value audit against all 33 prior terminal mechanisms. Only if the concept remains economically distinct may that audit freeze one exact formula, one direction, high-low ordering and zero-width semantics, no-return gates, and one finite trial before candidate or comparison values or returns are read.
